title: Solar Alarm 2-Pack – Siren and Flash on Motion
descriptionHtml:
There's a car in the driveway at two in the morning

The tools are in the shed, the bikes are under the carport and the boat is on its trailer behind the house. None of it can be seen from the bedroom window. You don't wake up because someone is walking there — you find out in the morning, when something is missing.

Movement in the dark is met with sound and flashing light

The sensor detects movement, the siren goes off and the flashing light starts pulsing. That is usually enough — someone testing a property is looking for the one that's quiet, not the one that screams. The solar cell on the top keeps the alarm charged, so it stays on the shed all season without you climbing up there with batteries.

Features

  • You hear it from inside the house – a siren that goes off on motion, not a silent camera you check afterwards
  • Visible from the other side of the yard – a flashing light that pulses together with the siren
  • No cable to the shed or carport – solar cell on the top that charges during the day
  • Stays up all year round – waterproof housing, built to be mounted outdoors
  • Covers two spots right away – 2-pack, for example the shed and the back side

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.

The scene images are AI-generated illustrations. The product photo shows the item as it is.
